title: Release manifest, schema version 1
description: Describes the contents of a portable SecurityReviewTool release ZIP. The files array is sorted by path (ordinal, forward-slash). SHA-256 hashes are lowercase hex. The manifest itself is excluded from the file listing.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version; must be exactly 1.

runtime_version.description: .NET runtime version used for the build.

sdk_version.description: .NET SDK version used for the build.

created_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of manifest creation.

files.description: Files in the release package, sorted by path (ordinal, forward-slash). The release-manifest.json entry itself is absent.

path.description: Relative path within the package using forward-slash separators. Must not contain '..' segments, absolute paths, or backslashes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the file content, lowercase hex.
